fourPieceEffectTexts.en: When an EX Special Attack hits an enemy, reduce the target's Anomaly Buildup RES to the equipper's Attribute by 20% for 8s. This effect does not stack with others of the same attribute.
fourPieceEffectTexts.zh-CN: [强化特殊技]命中敌人时，根据装备者的属性类型，使目标对应属性异常积蓄抗性降低20%，持续8秒，相同属性类型的效果不可叠加。
